candidate_freeze_and_confirmatory_window.development_data_boundary_rule: the effective development boundary is the earlier of the v4 confirmatory-window start and the preregistered development cutoff; a development candle that closes at or before that instant may be read, and no candle that closes after it may be read, so no candle inside the open v3 confirmatory window is ever read by a v4 run
candidate_freeze_and_confirmatory_window.min_confirmatory_window_rationale: 90 days of closed hourly candles after freeze
candidate_freeze_and_confirmatory_window.window_overlap_with_v3_confirmatory_wind: the v4 confirmatory window opens inside the open v3 confirmatory window in time; the two share no evaluated asset, because the v4 candidate set is disjoint from the v1, v2 and v3 candidate sets, and the v4 evaluation may start only after the v3 confirmatory gate clears (BRAIN-013 phase gates)

code_hash_constraint.chosen_approach: new code outside the hashed set (src/v4_campaign/), leaving compute_code_hash() unchanged; explicit re-authorization only if v1/v2 hashed paths are touched

deviation_disclosure.statement: The v4 campaign has no prior completed runs and therefore no v1/v2 alignment deviation to disclose. The deviation from completed v1 and v2 runs is disclosed by the v3 selection authorization and the v3 execution amendment.

execution_authorization.scope: this protocol records the benchmark rule and the data-manifest identity. It authorizes no run, no evaluation and no confirmatory-window read.

benchmark_rule.alignment: the asset series and the benchmark series are sliced to the same fold window before the frozen engine is called, so that the engine's index pairing equals the UTC-candle-close alignment of docs/research_protocol.md:101
benchmark_rule.exposure_rule: the benchmark dataset is development data; it lies entirely before the confirmatory window and no confirmatory-window candle is read
fail_closed: the benchmark series does not cover an evaluated window of the asset series
the benchmark series carries a different timestamp than the asset series inside an evaluated window
benchmark_rule.grid_rule: the 576 btc_ema_168 configurations per asset are evaluated, never dropped, re-derived or re-ranked
benchmark_rule.note: The v4 data manifest publishes no BTCUSDT entry. The benchmark dataset is referenced directly from the immutable v3 data area; it is external to the v4 data-manifest identity and is hash-verified before every use. The benchmark covers every evaluated validation window: the v4 asset datasets span the 26,280-hour window that ends at the preregistered development cutoff, the benchmark dataset ends two hours earlier, and the difference falls entirely outside the evaluated windows -- the 0.4 to 0.8 fractions of the span -- and inside the holdout-position fold, which the selection run never evaluates.

hashing.note: manifest_hash is the sha256 of the document body with manifest_hash removed, following the pattern of the other v2 and v3 artifacts.
